objectives.description: Confirm all changes live under agent-system/extensions/core/ only
Run deploy-headless.sh to regenerate the deploy tree
Confirm deployed copies match source store for all touched files
Scoped gate verification (batch-deferred from the full set) + live deployed hook exercise + final balance trace

approaches_tried.approach: Ran deploy-headless.sh; its own internal fast-gate verification reported 3/36 FAIL, all three being gate3/gate4/gate10 timeout kills -- re-ran --only-gate 3,4,10 narrower and gate3 passed clean (confirming load-sensitivity) but gate4 (task-reference lint) now reported a REAL finding against the freshly-deployed library+lint: a stray end in test-validate-no-task-references.sh's own header prose, invisible to every ad-hoc balance-trace snippet used earlier in this implementation (which share the old boolean-toggle's begin-checked-first blind spot for a same-line-both-tokens line) but correctly surfaced by the real new depth-counting parser. Reworded the prose (no literal substrings) and reconfirmed via a direct whole-tree marker_balance_report sweep (not the naive awk snippet).
approaches_tried.reason: see issue log; recorded as a costly-severity verification-gap

approaches_tried.approach: Running test-gate-cache-equivalence.sh's DEPLOYED copy directly failed its own git-worktree-fixture setup ('could not create a git worktree fixture') on every retry, while the SOURCE-STORE copy of the identical file always succeeded. Traced to a pre-existing, off-by-one REPO_ROOT computation in that script (calibrated for source-store path depth, which happens to still land inside the repo; deployed path depth lands one level ABOVE the repo root, outside any git worktree). Confirmed via direct path-arithmetic reproduction and a debug copy with suppression removed (revealed git's own 'fatal: not a git repository' underneath).
approaches_tried.reason: pre-existing defect unrelated to this task's own scope (task-reference marker resolution, not this unrelated script's path arithmetic); Phase 5 modifies no source files; recorded as a minor pre-existing-defect issue for a future owner. Re-verified this suite via its (working) source-store invocation instead: 15 passed, 2 failed, the same pre-existing documented gate10/gate4 load-sensitive timeout pair seen in Phase 1 -- no worktree failure there.

approaches_tried.approach: Exercised the live, deployed hook end-to-end via BOTH a synthetic jq-built payload AND real Edit/Write tool calls against real scratch files: an Edit inside a file-wide marker pair (no nested pair) was allowed, and an unmarked citation was still blocked (the Write call was itself denied by the live PreToolUse hook with the expected BLOCKED message).
approaches_tried.reason: confirms the dispatch's own observation is resolved in the live, deployed system, not merely in test fixtures

deviations.description: Phase declares Verification Tier: full, requiring the complete bash .claude/scripts/verify-deploy.sh and bash .claude/scripts/tests/run-all.sh battery
deviations.reason: Dispatch file's Batch Gate Deferral section directs this dispatch to discharge the phase against a scoped tier instead, deferring the full gate set to the once-per-invocation batch-level stage; see context/formats/plan-format.md's Batch-aware deferral subsection and context/contracts/phase-closure.md's no-promotion-without-evidence carve-out.
